newsitem.title: UK: Beckett named UK President of Board of Trade.
newsitem.headline: Beckett named UK President of Board of Trade.

text.p: Margaret Beckett has been named President of the Board of Trade (Industry Secretary) in Tony Blair's new Labour cabinet, an aide to Blair said.
The aide also said that John Prescott, who was earlier appointed deputy prime minister, would also be made responsible for the portfolios of environment and transport.
He added that Clare Short had been given a cabinet post, but gave no details. She held the overseas development post in opposition.
